title: Join Bash PROMPT_COMMAND hooks with newlines

semicolon-join.message: AGENTS.md: preserve the user's shell profile; a `;` after the user's PROMPT_COMMAND breaks values that already end in `;`, `&` or a newline.
semicolon-join.help: Join the user's PROMPT_COMMAND with a newline (for example a `$'\n'` variable) or extend the array form.
